verdict.rationale: Sentry's own alerts documentation says an alert rule can "call webhooks", so the product does make outbound HTTP callbacks when matching issues or monitor events fire. The evidence only shows this as an alert action, though, with no detail on webhook registration, payload format, event types, or signing. Slack, PagerDuty and Twilio notifications are chat or paging integrations and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose webhook subscription system with selectable event types, payload schema and delivery or signature docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
